description: cc-memory (calm) hooks for Codex CLI. Claude Code版はhooks/hooks.json。MessageDisplayはCodexに対応イベントが無いため未登録（表示専用機能のため代替なし）。sanitize_backfill_hookはCodexのrollout recorderが書き込みハンドルを保持しセッション中のrename書き換えがappend喪失を起こすことを実機確認したため未登録＝transcript backfill sanitizeはCodex非対応（漏出防止の主壁はPreToolUseのpreblock_hookが担う。#613）。

hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && CALM_HARNESS=codex exec uv run python hooks/hook_state.py clear
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && CALM_HARNESS=codex exec uv run python hooks/session_start_hook.py
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && CALM_HARNESS=codex exec uv run python hooks/stop_hook.py
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && CALM_HARNESS=codex exec uv run python hooks/user_prompt_submit_hook.py
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && CALM_HARNESS=codex exec uv run python hooks/preblock_hook.py
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && CALM_HARNESS=codex exec uv run python hooks/sanitize_tool_result_hook.py
